subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept the `openai/codex-action` 1.11 upgrade in workflows that pass an OpenAI API key after a direct source-contract audit, or should that upgrade be split from this grouped Dependabot PR?
rationale: The repository policy requires direct Codex source inspection for this credential-bearing runtime dependency, and that approval cannot be inferred from version numbers, pin changes, or ordinary CI status.

options.title: Audit and approve the Codex update
options.body: Review the 1.11 action source and release contract, verify its secret/input behavior for the affected workflows, and merge only after a successful final-head workflow run.

options.title: Split the Codex action bump
options.body: Land independently reviewed non-Codex action updates and route the Codex-action upgrade through a focused security/workflow review.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the Codex update
recommendation.body: Review the 1.11 action source and release contract, verify its secret/input behavior for the affected workflows, and merge only after a successful final-head workflow run.
